title: Tensor projection maps respect compact-support composition
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring. Work on the small etale sites with the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(T_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], exact constant-coefficient inverse image [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor]. All schemes mentioned are Noetherian [def-pc-scheme]. Compact-support direct image is the compactification-independent functor of [def-amb-etale-compact-support, lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Let $X\xrightarrow{f}Y\xrightarrow{g}Z$ be separated finite-type morphisms admitting compactifications, and let $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D(Z_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. For each morphism $a$ write
$$P_{a,Q,B}:Q\otimes_A^LRa_!B\longrightarrow Ra_!(a^*Q\otimes_A^LB)$$
for the tensor projection map obtained from the termwise open-extension tensor map and the proper projection map [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-slice-extension-tensor, def-kun-projection-formula-map]. Let $\alpha_{g,f}:Rg_!Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(gf)_!$ be the proper/open tower-normalized composition comparison of [lem-amb-unbounded-compact-support-comparisons]. Under $(gf)^*K=f^*g^*K$, the actual transformations satisfy
$$\alpha_{g,f,f^*g^*K\otimes M}\circ Rg_!(P_{f,g^*K,M})\circ P_{g,K,Rf_!M}
=P_{gf,K,M}\circ(1_K\otimes\alpha_{g,f,M}).$$
This identity includes compatibility with the proper/open interchange used in the tower and with the refinement comparisons. It holds on the whole ordinary derived categories, without boundedness or finite Tor-amplitude assumptions on $K,M$. Whenever the projection maps are invertible their inverses satisfy the equivalent identity.
